model_annotation: The image presents three donut charts comparing the number of enterprises, number of persons employed, and turnover by industry, construction, trade, and services in 2021, using absolute values and data from NACE Rev. 2. Each chart displays four distinct sectors, totaling four sectors across all three charts. The first chart, "NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES," shows the industry sector (blue) at 61% (19.0 million), construction (light blue) at 12% (3.7 million), trade (red) at 19% (5.9 million), and other services (yellow) at 8% (2.4 million); the percentages are displayed within the respective segments. The second chart, "NUMBER OF PERSONS EMPLOYED," shows industry (blue) at 51% (80.2 million), other services (yellow) at 21% (33.0 million), trade (red) at 19% (29.5 million), and construction (light blue) at 9% (13.4 million); the percentages are displayed within the respective segments. The third chart, "TURNOVER," shows other services (blue) at 33% (10.6 trillion), industry (yellow) at 31% (9.8 trillion), trade (red) at 31% (9.9 trillion), and construction (light blue) at 6% (1.9 trillion); the percentages are displayed within the respective segments. A legend at the bottom of the image defines the color coding for the four sectors: industry (yellow), construction (light blue), trade (red), and other services (blue). All three charts include percentage labels within each segment, and the sectors are visually arranged in a clockwise order based on their size in each respective chart.
